The *Dutiyapāṭidesanīya* ("Second Pāṭidesanīya") of the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* sets forth a disciplinary training rule concerning the conduct of monks during invitational meals. According to the rule, a monk attending an invitational meal who fails to intervene and instruct a nun to cease directing the distribution of food incurs an offense requiring acknowledgment (*pāṭidesanīya*). The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
